_comment: The re-grab loop, as the queue shows it. All titles INVENTED (INV-15).
Rows 1+2 are ONE season pack behind ONE downloadId covering TWO episodes
- they must collapse to a single ledger key (sonarr|1234|5678,5679),
otherwise a pack would need MAX_ADDS re-grabs per episode.
Row 3   is a different episode of the SAME series behind a different hash
- INV-10: its adds must never count toward the pack's.
Row 4   is a Radarr row (movieId keyed).
Row 5   is the UNKEYABLE case: includeUnknownSeriesItems=true gives a row
with no seriesId and no episodeId. The guard must decline to act
on it and the sweep must behave exactly as it did before (INV-7).
